subject: Health Portal - Appointment Rescheduled
body:
Dear $patient_name,

Your health appointment has been successfully rescheduled.

PREVIOUS APPOINTMENT
===================
Date: $old_date
Time: $old_time

NEW APPOINTMENT DETAILS
======================
Date: $date
Time: $time
Practitioner: $practitioner
Department: $department
Location: $location

Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment time.

$signature
